$comment: Pinned state of the three upstream skills this repo merges.
The upstream-sync workflow compares these SHAs against upstream HEAD on a
schedule and opens a review PR when a watched path changes. It never edits
SKILL.md or the reference files: a merged, conflict-resolved skill cannot
absorb upstream prose automatically without reintroducing the contradictions
it exists to settle. See AGENTS.md, 'When a source publishes a new version'.
branch is optional: when null, the repo's current default branch is resolved at run time, so an upstream default-branch rename does not break the check.
When you finish a re-merge by hand, bump merged_version and last_reviewed.
